scope: Pilot continuation rule for the five existing validation clips; no population-level guarantee

requirements: finite SMPL-X FK and 133 landmarks for every frame
matching anatomical x orientation and unshifted frame comparison within +/-4 frames
each median wrist and fingertip error at most 0.2 observed shoulder widths

notes: Thresholds are operational pilot criteria. Five fits come from five source recordings. Same-recording control is available for one query; other queries have cross-recording controls only.
